annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions – Ethical Artificial Intelligence and access to supercomputing for start-ups
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Committee of the Regions – Ethical Artificial Intelligence and access to supercomputing for start-ups
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Committee of the Regions opinion on the Commission's proposal to amend the EuroHPC Regulation so AI start-ups can access supercomputing through AI Factories. It proposes amendments stressing local and regional roles, transparent access criteria and reduced SME burden under the AI Act, and gives policy recommendations on ethics, talent, sandboxes and funding.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amendments add regional and local involvement to AI Factories and EuroHPC objectives
Access criteria for supercomputers should be transparent, with public information from early stages
Access conditions should minimise administrative burden and apply the AI Act flexibly for start-ups and SMEs
Recommends regional AI sandboxes, talent hubs and an observer seat for the CoR on the EuroHPC Board
Humans must remain in control of AI; bias, privacy and security measures should be documented
